APPROPRIATIONS

 

     §52.  That appropriations, except as herein otherwise provided, shall be made by the legislature. [Am May 27, 1910, c 258, §3, 36 Stat 444]

 

  Referred to in 15 H. 364, 535; 16 H. 245; 20 H. 518; see note to §54.
